rules.summary: Material must match its declared kind (skill, prompt, mcp, or package).
Checkout license files must satisfy the recipe SPDX license.
Reject symlinks that point outside the checkout.
Reject remote-shell patterns in skills, prompts, and package lifecycle scripts.
Reject instruction-override text that tells an agent to ignore earlier instructions.
Reject git URLs that can run a helper during fetch, such as ext::.
Reject checkouts that match a published abom advisory.
